title: McDiarmid–Mitsche–Pratat Lower Bound Problem
statement_text: Prove a nontrivial lower bound for $\chi_c(G(n, 1/2))$ with high probability.
context_text: McDiarmid, Mitsche and Pratat (arXiv:1611.01782) proved that $\chi_c(G(n,1/2)) \leq (1/2+o(1))\log_2 n$ whp and raised the problem of establishing any nontrivial lower bound for the clique chromatic number of the dense random graph. No nontrivial lower bound was known prior to the present paper.
paper_contribution: Proves that there exists an absolute constant $c > 0$ such that $\chi_c(G(n,1/2)) \geq c\log_2 n$ whp, establishing $\chi_c(G(n,1/2)) = \Theta(\log n)$ whp and thereby fully settling the problem.

title: Informal Conjecture on Tight Constant for Clique Chromatic Number
statement_text: It seems plausible that $\chi_c(G(n, 1/2)) = (1/2 + o(1)) \log n$ whp.
context_text: A clique is maximal if it is not properly contained in a larger clique. A clique coloring of $G$ is a vertex coloring in which no maximal clique with at least two vertices is monochromatic, and the clique chromatic number $\chi_c(G)$ is the minimum number of colors of a clique coloring. $G(n,1/2)$ is the binomial random graph, whp means with probability tending to $1$ as $n\to\infty$, and logarithms are in base 2. McDiarmid, Mitsche and Prałat proved $\chi_c(G(n,1/2))\le(1/2+o(1))\log n$ whp and asked for any nontrivial lower bound; the authors prove $\chi_c(G(n,1/2))\ge\frac{1}{2000}\log n$ whp, so $\chi_c=\Theta(\log n)$, and the same holds for every fixed edge probability $p\in(0,1)$ (although the ratio between the upper bound $\Theta(\log n/p)$ and their lower bound $\Omega(\log n/\log(1/p))$ grows as $p\to0$). They made no attempt to optimize constants; the constant $\frac1{2000}$ can certainly be improved, but their method does not seem sufficient to determine the tight constant, which they suggest matches the upper bound.
notes: Stated in the concluding remarks without a labelled environment, using the phrase 'It seems plausible that'. All logarithms in the paper are base 2 unless otherwise specified. PDF source.
